name: Chaos Emerges
description: At the beginning of all things, Chaos - the primal void - exists before any ordered universe.

name: The Rise of the Titans
description: From Chaos emerge the Titans, including Kronos and Rhea, who establish cosmic order.

name: The Rise of the Olympians
description: Zeus leads the Olympian gods in revolt against the Titans, establishing a new divine order.

name: The Golden Apple of Discord
description: Eris, goddess of discord, throws a golden apple inscribed 'For the Fairest' among the gods.

name: Paris's Judgment
description: Paris judges among Hera, Athena, and Aphrodite. Aphrodite wins by promising him the most beautiful woman.

name: Aphrodite's Reward
description: Aphrodite grants Paris Helen as his lover, setting destiny in motion.

name: Helen's Abduction
description: Paris abducts Helen from Sparta, taking her to Troy across the Aegean Sea.

name: Achilles Slays Hector
description: Greatest warrior of Greeks faces Troy's strongest defender. Achilles kills Hector in single combat.

name: The Trojan Horse
description: Greeks construct a massive wooden horse, filled with soldiers, tricking the Trojans into taking it inside their walls.

name: Troy's Fall
description: Greek soldiers emerge from the horse, slaughtering the Trojans and ending the ten-year war.

name: Odysseus Departs Troy
description: After Troy's fall, Odysseus sets sail for home with his men, beginning a ten-year journey.

name: The Cyclops Encounter
description: Odysseus and his men are trapped in Polyphemus's cave. Odysseus blinds the Cyclops to escape.

name: Poseidon's Wrath
description: Poseidon, enraged over his son's blinding, curses Odysseus to wander the seas for years.

name: Odysseus Returns to Ithaca
description: After years of trials, Odysseus finally returns home to Ithaca and his faithful wife Penelope.

name: The Nemean Lion
description: Heracles's first labor: slay the invulnerable Nemean Lion. He discovers strangulation works where weapons fail.

name: The Lernaean Hydra
description: Heracles's second labor: defeat the multi-headed Hydra. Each head regrows when cut, defeated by cauterization.

name: Cerberus Captured
description: Heracles's twelfth and final labor: capture Cerberus from the Underworld without weapons.

name: Labors Complete
description: After twelve near-impossible tasks, Heracles is freed from servitude and earns immortal glory.

name: Perseus's Divine Birth
description: Zeus disguises himself as Danae's husband to conceive Perseus, an illegitimate demigod.

name: Medusa's Slaying
description: Armed with Hermes's winged sandals and Athena's shield, Perseus slays Medusa without meeting her gaze.

name: Andromeda's Rescue
description: Perseus rescues Andromeda from a sea monster, marrying her and founding the dynasty of Mycenae.

name: The Labyrinth Quest
description: Theseus volunteers as a sacrifice, entering the Labyrinth with Ariadne's help (a ball of string to mark his path).

name: The Minotaur's Slaying
description: Theseus navigates the Labyrinth and defeats the Minotaur in combat, freeing Athens from tribute.

name: Theseus Becomes King
description: Theseus becomes king of Athens, uniting the city-states and establishing a more democratic rule.

name: The Argonauts Gather
description: Jason assembles the greatest heroes of Greece aboard the ship Argo for the quest of the Golden Fleece.

name: Quest for the Golden Fleece
description: The Argonauts face numerous trials: dangerous straits, island giants, and mythical beasts.

name: Medea's Assistance
description: Medea, daughter of the Colchian king, uses magic to help Jason obtain the Golden Fleece and escape.

name: Hades Abducts Persephone
description: Hades erupts from the earth in a dark chariot, seizing Persephone and taking her to the Underworld.

name: Demeter's Grief
description: Demeter, inconsolable, causes the earth to wither and crops to fail, bringing famine to humanity.

name: The Seasonal Bargain
description: Zeus negotiates: Persephone spends part of the year with Hades, creating seasons as Demeter mourns her absence.

name: Prometheus Steals Fire
description: Prometheus, defying Zeus, steals fire from Mount Olympus and brings it to humanity.

name: Prometheus's Eternal Punishment
description: Zeus punishes Prometheus by chaining him to a rock, where an eagle eats his liver daily, which regenerates.

name: Heracles Frees Prometheus
description: Centuries later, Heracles slays the eagle and frees Prometheus from his eternal torment.

name: Pandora Is Created
description: As punishment for Prometheus's theft, Zeus has Hephaestus create Pandora, the first woman, with hidden gifts.

name: Pandora Opens the Box
description: Despite warnings, Pandora opens a sealed jar (often called a box), curious about its contents.

name: Evils Released Upon Humanity
description: Sickness, death, suffering, and countless evils escape into the world. Only hope remains at the bottom.

name: Aphrodite and Ares Fall in Love
description: The love goddess and war god begin a secret romance, though Aphrodite is married to Hephaestus.

name: Hephaestus's Trap
description: Hephaestus, learning of the affair, forges an invisible net to catch the lovers in the act.

name: The Gods' Laughter
description: The trapped lovers are exposed to all the gods on Mount Olympus, causing divine amusement and scandal.

name: Midas Wishes for Gold
description: King Midas finds the drunken god Dionysus and, helping him, is granted one wish.

name: The Golden Touch Curse
description: Midas wishes that everything he touches turns to gold, but soon realizes this includes his food and loved ones.

name: Midas's Regret
description: Midas begs Dionysus to undo the wish. The god agrees, and Midas bathes in a river to wash away the curse.

name: Echo's Unrequited Love
description: Echo, a nymph cursed to only repeat others' words, falls hopelessly in love with the vain Narcissus.

name: Narcissus Sees His Reflection
description: Narcissus encounters his own reflection in a pool and falls in love with it, not realizing it is himself.

name: The Narcissus Flower
description: Unable to leave his reflection, Narcissus withers and dies, transformed into the narcissus flower.

name: The Wedding Night
description: The fifty daughters of Danaus marry the fifty sons of Aegyptus. All agrees to the marriage contract.

name: The Husbands Slain
description: On the wedding night, all but one of the Danaids murder their husbands in obedience to their father.

name: Eternal Punishment
description: The Danaids are punished in the Underworld, eternally trying to fill a leaky jar with water.

name: Heracles Seeks the Girdle
description: Heracles's ninth labor: obtain the golden girdle of Hippolyta, queen of the warrior Amazons.

name: Battle with Hippolyta
description: Heracles and Theseus fight the Amazons. Heracles defeats Hippolyta in single combat.

name: The Girdle Obtained
description: Heracles claims Hippolyta's girdle as proof of his labor's completion.
